title: Trailer for my AI RPG: every scene is painted, voiced and scored as you play (solo dev, pipeline below)
author: JarJarBeatU
selftext:
Solo dev here (UCI CS senior). Slopverse is a browser AI RPG: you play a character, and every turn comes back as a scene, painted, voiced and scored. This trailer is cut from real gameplay recordings (transitions and the end card added). How a turn works:

- Story: Gemini Flash writes every line; nothing downstream rewrites it, everything else reads the prose.
- Direction: smaller model calls decide who's in each shot, who speaks, and the mood.
- Pictures: each shot is painted as the scene unfolds, with depth so the camera can move through it.
- Voices and music: every character has their own voice; the music follows the mood.
- Code: I direct a crew of AI coding agents and review, test and play it daily.

What surprised me: players will wait a few seconds if the scene arrives whole; a half-loaded scene feels broken.

No-sign-up demo: https://slopverse.ai/demo (pick what happens next in a scene played once in the real game). Happy to go deep on any part.
